task_description: Issue #39: persistent monster zukan (collection of reached appearances = tier x form). Survives reset (separate ddm.zukan localStorage key). Records first-seen timestamp, days raised, and name at first discovery of each appearance. Accessible JA/EN modal opened from a header button, with undiscovered entries shown as silhouettes and a discovered/total count. Pure collection logic (canonical set, entry keying, first-seen merge, counts) in @ddm/shared and unit-tested; frontend-only, additive, no Monster-type/backend/infra change.

non_blocking_notes: No historical backfill: a monster loaded already past baby records only its current stageId x form; earlier stages for pre-existing saves are not retroactively recorded (inherent design, not a regression).
daysRaised is total age-from-bornAt at first discovery, not per-stage dwell time (matches the issue's 育成日数 wording).
No jsdom/lifecycle tests for the useMonster storage wiring or modal keyboard a11y; only the pure core + glue + formatters are unit-tested.

verification.summary: npm run build passes for the whole monorepo. Shared tests 126/126 pass (baseline 117 + 9 zukan core tests). Frontend ui-helpers tests 107/107 pass (baseline 99 + 8 zukan glue/formatter tests). Tests exercise real pure logic: canonical 10-appearance enumeration, first-seen merge (object-identity no-op on re-record), days-raised floor/clamp, counts, sanitizeZukan dropping malformed/non-canonical, parseZukan JSON+sanitize, and the localized count/days/date formatters. Verified reset() does NOT read/write/clear ddm.zukan (only a comment references it; no removeItem/clear anywhere in frontend), so the collection survives reset. Discovery recorded in commit() + mount path on every (stageId x form) change. No Docker in repo (frontend-only web app). No new runtime deps; no backend/infra/Monster-type change.
